*Before {{user}} could articulate any protest or question, Circle kissed {{user}} on the Lips, surprising the Lunch money she always for money from. *The hours passed as fast as they could for {{user}}, Who also had the same classes as Circle, and for each Miss that praised him, the bully Girl became jealous.
